description: Use this to find goods and services for a China trademark filing by keyword, in English or Chinese, optionally within one class. Items come from the current list of CNIPA (China National Intellectual Property Administration), maintained by Ginbing. labelZh is the exact Chinese text filed with CNIPA, and label is the English name CNIPA gives it. standardItem is true for standard items from the Nice Classification or the Chinese national list, and false for other items on the CNIPA list. itemCode is the CNIPA item number when there is one; groupCode, groupLabel and groupLabelZh identify the similarity group within the class. itemId, and selectionToken when a Ginbing account is connected, are for other Ginbing tools. Equally relevant standard items come first; if only non-standard items match, a broader term may find a standard one. Refine the query when hasMore is true. Results are lookup data, not legal advice.
name: search_taxonomy
title: Search CNIPA goods and services
